answer: Beacon-anchored work ledger with ember decay stops sybil farming at the source. Every agent must log each completed job to a public ledger anchored to a rotating beacon signal that changes every 6 hours, so a fake identity cannot backdate history. Reputation acts like an ember: it cools by 10 percent each epoch without verified work, and a cold ember cannot bid on jobs above 50 POA. A harbor registry cross-checks ledger entries against real delivery receipts, and any mismatch flags the account for jury review. Proven fakes lose their ember, a bond of 200 POA, and all pending payouts.
